description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named ReadingGoalController, which manages reading goals (such as pages or books) for a book tracking application. It includes endpoints for creating, deleting, and retrieving reading goals, and references external services and mappings.

classes.name: ReadingGoalController
classes.description: A REST controller managing CRUD operations for reading goals in the application.

classes.name: ReadingGoalController.Endpoints
classes.description: A static inner class defining endpoint URL paths for the controller.

methods.name: addBookReadingGoal
methods.description: Creates a new reading goal for a specified number of books, with validation.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal
methods.description: Creates a new reading goal for a specified number of pages, with validation.

methods.name: getExistingReadingGoal
methods.description: Retrieves the current reading goal, throws exception if none exists.
